notes: CONFLICTS BETWEEN UK SOURCES (kept as separate items/rules): (1) Lisinopril + breastfeeding: Zestril SmPC and MHRA DSU (May 2009) say 'not recommended' (rule lisinopril:breastfeeding:smpc-mhra, level avoid); MHRA clarification (July 2009) says not absolutely contraindicated; SPS (2023) says lisinopril 'can be used with caution', enalapril preferred (rule lisinopril:breastfeeding:sps, level caution). (2) Spironolactone + ACE inhibitors: Aldactone SmPC 4.5 says ACE inhibitors 'should not routinely be used with Aldactone' (avoid); MHRA DSU 2016 (heart failure) says the combination 'should be used with caution' with lowest doses and regular K/renal monitoring (caution). Two rules kept. (3) Spironolactone tablets (Aldactone, Pfizer) vs oral suspension (Qaialdo, Nova) SmPCs differ: suspension adds essential hypertension; tablets contraindicate 'significant renal compromise' with no number, suspension gives GFR < 30 ml/min (adults) and GFR 30-<60 (children); tablets contraindicate any hyperkalaemia, suspension > 5.5 mEq/L, SPS monitoring page says contraindicated if baseline K > 5.0 mmol/L; HF creatinine limits are in mg/dL (tablets) vs micromol/L (suspension); pregnancy: tablets 'should not be used unless benefit justifies risk', suspension 'not recommended'. Rules are formulation-scoped where they differ. (4) Spironolactone potassium action thresholds: SmPC (severe HF) stop/interrupt if K > 5 mEq/L; SPS reduce dose if K > 5.5 and < 6 mmol/L, stop and seek advice if > 6 mmol/L. Both shown. (5) Isosorbide mononitrate: the three SmPCs differ. Imdur (TopRidge, last updated on emc 2018) lists fewer contraindications (no raised ICP, glaucoma, hypovolaemia, riociguat) and calls hypotension a 'relative contraindication'; the IR tablet (Dexcel) and Elantan LA SmPCs contraindicate very low BP/severe hypotension. IR SmPC itself lists severe hypotension in 4.3 and also 'hypotension' as a relative contraindication. Rules are formulation-scoped. LEVEL DECISIONS FOR REVIEW: items placed in SmPC section 4.3 but worded 'should not be used/given' (ISMN IR tablet and Elantan LA 4.3 list; Viagra 'men for whom sexual activity is inadvisable') were coded as contraindicated, with sourceWording noting the phrasing. Sildenafil PAH: the 'most potent CYP3A4 inhibitors' contraindication (ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir) is NOT coded as a group:strong-cyp3a4-inhibitor rule because batch E places clarithromycin in that group while the Revatio SmPC puts clarithromycin in a middle category (dose 20 mg once daily); none of the most potent inhibitors is in the master list, so it is in sections only. AGE-LIMITED RENAL RULES (added in audit B, engine now supports age on renal/condition rules): lisinopril GFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m2 in children (avoid, age < 18); spironolactone suspension GFR < 60 ml/min in children (contraindicated, age < 18); spironolactone tablets 'moderate to severe renal impairment' in children has no number, so it is a condition rule (renal-impairment, age < 18). 'Children' is taken as under 18 years (the SmPCs define the paediatric population up to 17/18 years). ISMN 'dosage should be reduced in renal impairment' has no threshold, so no renal rule. Lisinopril CrCl bands 10-30 and 31-80 are encoded as [10,31) and [31,81). NOT FOUND / NOT USED: no SPS breastfeeding page for spironolactone, nitrates/ISMN or sildenafil; no BUMPS leaflet for isosorbide mononitrate/nitrates (BUMPS class leaflets used for ACE inhibitors, diuretics, calcium-channel blockers); SPS 'Suggestions for drug monitoring in adults in primary care' URL returned 404 and was not found by search; no SPS monitoring page for nitrates, amlodipine or sildenafil; no MHRA DSU specific to ISMN/nitrates; no UK source found saying ISMN MR (or any batch B medicine) must be prescribed by brand. UKTIS monographs not used. NICE not used. SCOPE: amlodipine oral solution (Zydus, emc 102452) was checked and matches the tablet SmPC in indications, dosing and contraindications (differs only in excipients: maltitol, ethanol, glycerol), so no separate formulation. Not covered: lisinopril oral solution, Viagra Connect (pharmacy medicine), sildenafil orodispersible products, Revatio injection, Aldactone 50/100 mg strengths (same product family). OTHER: Aldactone 4.8 frequencies were read from the SmPC table layout (flattened in text); explicit frequencies are quoted from the Qaialdo SmPC. MHRA DSU June 2026 (ACE inhibitor angioedema) says SmPC updates are in progress; the Zestril SmPC (revised 08/05/2026) already mentions bradykinin-mediated angioedema. Group memberships for nsaid, potassium-supplement, oral-antidiabetic, cyp3a4-inhibitor/inducer and vitamin-k-antagonist come from other batches. BNF/BNFC not accessed (geo-blocked). AUDIT B (2026-10-17): see scripts/medcheck-uk/audit/B.md for all changes. Vocab overlap for the integrator: 'hereditary-fructose-intolerance' (batch E) and 'hereditary-sugar-intolerance' (batch G) overlap; batch B uses hereditary-sugar-intolerance for sucrose statements (fructose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency) and hereditary-fructose-intolerance for the sorbitol (HFI-only) statement. lisinopril:interaction:methotrexate cites emc-511 (batch F source) for methotrexate's immunosuppressive effect. BACK-FILL 2026-10-17 (new master-list medicines and groups, from the batch B sources already used): amlodipine + azole antifungals; lisinopril + ARBs (avoid: SmPC 4.4 + MHRA RAS-combination DSU), vildagliptin, vildagliptin/metformin and racecadotril (angioedema, caution), insulins, tricyclic antidepressants, sympathomimetics; spironolactone + ARBs (caution: SmPC 4.4 + MHRA), other diuretics (dose: about 50% reduction; dilution hyponatraemia), aspirin; isosorbide mononitrate + beta-blockers, ARBs, tricyclic antidepressants, MAO inhibitors; sildenafil + alpha-blockers (ED SmPC: dose, consider a 25 mg start; PAH SmPCs: caution). Not given separate rules because existing group rules already cover them: verapamil, diltiazem, fluconazole (members of cyp3a4-inhibitor) and carbamazepine (member of cyp3a4-inducer) for amlodipine and sildenafil. No new group memberships for batch B.
